scripts.build: npm run build -w @motionvector/webcodecs-census && npm run build -w @motionvector/webcodecs-census-cdp && npm run build -w @motionvector/webcodecs-census-mcp
scripts.release: npm run preflight && npm run build && npm test && npm publish -w @motionvector/webcodecs-census && npm publish -w @motionvector/webcodecs-census-cdp && npm publish -w @motionvector/webcodecs-census-mcp

scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:extension && npm run build:fixtures
